key.name: accent-per-workspace
key.description: The shell and Amethystora's apps take the accent of the workspace shown. Other apps keep the theme's.

key.name: workspace-accents
key.description: One of amethyst, iris, sky, lagoon, jade, moss, amber, ember, coral, rose, orchid and slate for each workspace in order, or theme for the desktop's own. A workspace past the list, and anything else in it, takes the desktop's own.
